results.fact: Itinerary total note gain vs gain_ft
results.evidence: itinerary.totalNote says ~7,900 ft gain while gain_ft and the itinerary day sum are 8,100 (7,900 is the loss sum). The only outside figure found is 2,685 m (~8,800 ft) for Duckabush-to-Marmot Lake, which agrees with neither; no source states car-to-car gain for this summit trip. Would settle: any outside car-to-car gain figure for Duckabush via Marmot Lake.

The published standard line (Route 2 in the Olympic climbing guide, reproduced on the Mountaineers route page and cited in Wikipedia's summary) descends NE from Carrie's summit down the Carrie Glacier, circles north of Fairchild and ascends the Southwest Ridge. The NE-facing glacier is the approach; the summit line is the SW Ridge, so face/aspect describe the finishing ridge and do not conflict with the glacier approach.

results.fact: Approach corridor: High Divide/Cat Basin (approach, approach_variants) vs Appleton Pass (waypoints)
results.evidence: approach and approach_variants[0] route the party Sol Duc > Deer Lake > High Divide > Cat Basin junction (~10.2 mi), but the waypoints list an Appleton Pass Trail junction (4.9 mi) and Appleton Pass (7.3 mi) before the Cat Walk. Both corridors are used for the Bailey Range, but the page presents them as one line. Not researched to two sources in this pass; waypoint coordinates are out of scope. Would settle: owner choice of which corridor the waypoint list represents, then rename/re-note pins or add an approach variant.

gain_ft 4,495 equals only day 2 of the 5-day itinerary (sum 10,744). Outside totals for Sol Duc to North Fork Quinault Bailey Range traverses disagree widely: 21,800 ft over 61.5 mi (one 5-day party), 15,000 ft over 57.8 mi (another variant), 26k ft over 61 mi (loop). None matches this itinerary and no two agree. Would settle: two sources stating car-to-car gain for the same Sol Duc-to-Low Divide/N Fork Quinault line.

Low Divide to the North Fork Quinault trailhead is about 16 mi (two sources), so day 5's 5 mi cannot reach it; fixing it needs new day-5 miles, hours, trip total and timing.sectionBreakdown hours that no source states for this itinerary (parties split the exit differently, e.g. camping at Elip Creek). Would settle: a published day-by-day exit schedule for this line, or an owner decision to restructure days 4-5.
